palette: silk-scroll deep red ground + pale silk panels + ink brush annotations + gold seal accents + dark writing ink
typography: ink brush headings on silk panels, dark scroll label tabs with gold left bar, gold seal stamps for verdicts, pale silk insets for quotes, thin ink underline for terms
composition: four institutional plaques arranged as a silk scroll spread with article tabs; the core principle gets its own large panel; the seasonal execution note anchors the bottom
surface: flat deep red ground with faint silk-weave hairlines, pale silk panels with hairline weathered borders and corner seal dots, no gradients, no rounded cards, no drop shadows
motion: silk panels unroll from right to left, brush annotations ink in, gold seal stamps land once per verdict
transition: a silk roller sweeps and the scroll clears for the next passage
